Adjacent paragraphs retain independent fills and borders; unshaded content stays unshaded in independently reopened DOCX.
Live footer PAGE field renders 1 and 2 with the entire authored title suffix; field and suffix retain bold blue 14pt styling.
Independent PDF text placement and reopened DOCX retain distinct authored custom tabs for otherwise equal paragraphs.
A six-point minimum row grows around three authored lines in an independent consumer and remains non-fixed in reopened DOCX.
Invalid dimensions and fill strings are omitted while source cell text and valid right borders remain visible and the ODF package validates.
A two-column section keeps its authored gap and explicit column break in an independent PDF; neighboring paragraphs retain independent keep-together values in reopened DOCX.
A keep-together paragraph followed by a plain paragraph and another kept paragraph remains distinct in independently reopened DOCX.
Raw DOCX run-child leading column break imports as an inline model node and independently renders in the right ODT column without leaking into the following plain paragraph.
Raw DOCX midparagraph column break stays at its exact content boundary, preserving bold/italic runs and applying the authored first-line indent only to the first fragment.
